CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.title: STAGE0 member distribution disclosure versus the fixed twin-count output form
CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.contract: C-6.1 requires the scored member distribution when the twin is invalid. C-6.3 final sentence asks for the STAGE0 member within-error distribution. The adopted output schema instead defines stage0_within_error_distribution as n=8 and the reference twin HIT count, and omits it on TWIN_INVALID.
CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.producer_form: score.alternatives[] carries member_within_error_counts from the distribution over all scored members (v003g L4289-L4294).
CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.tested: Two member counts [8,3] give producer-form n=2,min=3,median=5.5,max=8; B reports only n=8,within_error=8. For an invalid reference twin with member counts [0,3], B reports TWIN_INVALID and no member distribution. Both are classified without stops; R-DRIFT remains OPEN in the invalid-twin case.
CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.ruling_needed: Clarify whether C-6 requires echoing the all-member distribution, with a synchronized text/schema correction or report field if so. The existing twin-row count may remain separately named.
CONTRACT_AMBIGUITIES.A115: Nonblocking reporting ambiguity: no wrong classification, reason, row reading, physics/gate/blinding effect demonstrated.
